Key observations

Tested page

Mobile loading performance

Example page: Page 000

The tested page scored 39/100 for mobile performance in PageSpeed Insights.

This laboratory score is a reason to investigate, not a measurement of lost enquiries or bookings.

Next step: Ask your developer to inspect the main loading bottlenecks. Check the journey from your main offer to enquiry or booking on a phone.

1 page to review

Preferred page versions

Example page: Page 000

These settings can be intentional. The crawl does not establish whether Google lists a page.

Next step: Tell your website provider which offers should be found in search. Have them check these settings before changing anything.

1 page to review

Missing search descriptions

Example page: Page 000

Clear wording can help people distinguish your offers. Search engines may choose different text.

Next step: Review whether these pages belong with the current offers before editing descriptions. Confirm their purpose with the owner; retain intentional archives.

1 page to review

Missing image descriptions

Example page: Page 000

Useful image descriptions support visitors using screen readers. Image delivery and layout also deserve a check on a phone.

Next step: Ask your editor to describe informative images; decorative images may need empty descriptions. Ask your developer to check image sizes and layout where flagged.

1 page to review

Missing image dimensions

Example page: Page 000

Check whether image dimensions are set to help avoid unexpected layout shifts.

Next step: Ask your developer to check the image dimensions and layout on the affected pages.

1 page to review

Missing main headings

Example page: Page 000

Headings help visitors and screen-reader users understand the offer. These observations do not prove a ranking problem.

Next step: Ask your editor to check the affected pages. Make the main offer clear and arrange headings in a useful reading order.
